title: Complete remaining OpenCode live lifecycle smoke
outcome: The real OpenCode 1.18.8 tm-6ty smoke proved readiness, session spawn, streaming, external-session continuity, live model options, and the TermAl MCP bridge. Two lifecycle paths remain unverified against the real binary: (1) stop while a genuinely long prompt is still streaming, proving session/cancel plus bounded settlement; and (2) restart TermAl with a persisted OpenCode externalSessionId, proving session/resume preserves the same conversation. Unit coverage exists, and no defect is currently observed; this task records empirical verification rather than a known bug.
acceptance: A real OpenCode prompt is canceled while still active and settles within the documented contract with its external session id retained; after a real TermAl restart, the same persisted OpenCode session resumes and answers a follow-up without replacement continuity.
